newsitem.title: USA: Genzyme Tissue gets funding from parent.
newsitem.headline: Genzyme Tissue gets funding from parent.

text.p: Genzyme Tissue Repair said it has received $10 million from Genzyme Corp for one million shares of Genzyme Tissue Repair.
Genzyme Tissue Repair, a publicly traded division of Genzyme, plans to use the additional $10 million in capital for general business purposes, the company said.

Genzyme Corp retains an option to allocate an additional $10 million from Genzyme General to Genzyme Tissue Repair in exchange for an increase in Genzyme Tissue Repair designated shares at the rate of $10 per share, Genzyme Tissue said.
This remaining option expires on June 15, 1998, the company said.
Genzyme Corp now holds 3,182,000 shares of Genzyme Tissue Repair.
